newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Mugabe calls for urgent end to Sierra Leone coup.
newsitem.headline: Mugabe calls for urgent end to Sierra Leone coup.

text.p: Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe called on Monday for urgent restoration of democratic rule in Sierra Leone, but made no direct reference to military efforts by West African states to reinstate President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah.

Speaking at the start of a three-day Organisation of African Unity (OAU), Mugabe -- who becomes chairman of the 53-member body during the conference -- said the summit would discuss the Sierra Leone coup "and make a pronouncement on the issue".
"Democracy must be restored in that country as a matter of urgency," he said.
Mugabe also called for the restoration of constitutional legality in Burundi, where President Pierre Buyoya assumed power last year in another military coup.
Kabbah was overthrown by junior military officers a week ago and West African states, led by Nigeria, on Monday seemed to be carrying out their threat to use military force to restore him to office.
